newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest direct hogs seen off $1.00 - dealers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest direct hogs seen off $1.00 - dealers.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hog prices Monday were seen $1.00 per cwt lower as producers likely will sell hogs held back by this week's cold weather, according to livestock dealers and packer buyers.

Marketings were seen increasing dramatically next week after dangerously low wind chills and blizzard-like conditions brought movement to a near halt late this week in most of the Midwest, sources said.
Interior Iowa and southern Minnesota top hog prices delivered to plants could range from $53.50 to $54.50. One packer buyer said he also bid $1.00 lower for Tuesday.
